title: shipped seedream 5.0 lite and gemini 3.1 flash
summary: models are faster today. also moved our pitch deck to slidev. if we have to explain the business, it's happening in markdown and getting committed to git

highlights.title: Seedream 5.0
highlights.text: New `seedream5` model added for image generation. It's lighter, newer, and available on the [Unified API](https://gen.pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: Gemini 3.1 Arrives
highlights.text: Upgraded `gemini-large` to 3.1 Pro and added `nanobanana-2` (Gemini 3.1 Flash) for high-speed image generation.
